run_adsorb_atoms: run adsorb_atoms to compute adsorption energy for an ASE adslab atoms object with a calculator
compute_adsorption_energy_hybrid: compute hybrid adsorption energy using DFT slab energies and ML relaxed adslab energies
relax_adsorbate_surface: relax the adsorbate on a surface and compute predicted adsorption energy with surface relaxation
save_relaxed_adslab: run adsorb_atoms with save_relaxed_atoms to get JSON-encoded relaxed adslab and slab atoms
review_adsorb_atoms: review the adsorb_atoms function that computes direct, hybrid, and full adsorption energy results
